newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar, A-55 dissolve joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar, A-55 dissolve joint venture.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc and privately held A-55 LP said Tuesday they decided to dissolve their joint venture, Advanced Fuels LLC, which was formed in July 1994.
This action will enable both companies to pursue different programs with low emission aqueous fuel technology.
Caterpillar retains licensed rights to the aqueous fuel technology. It will focus its activities on the kinds of products it produces or will produce.
Reno, Nev.-based A-55 will pursue the application of aqueous fuel technology in all markets.
